population.definition: Victoria, listed as an agglomeration (status 'Aggl') in Mahe, at the census of 1 July 2022; citypopulation.de attributes the 2022 figure to the National Statistics Bureau, Seychelles. The page does not define the boundary (Victoria district vs Greater Victoria) and the census type code is 'Cfa'. Boundary NOT verified against NBS.

source.quote: 2022-07-01 | Cfa | 29,664 (sources: National Statistics Bureau, Seychelles)

facts.claim: The town on Mahe that became Victoria was founded by the French in 1778; the island had been claimed by France in 1756.

facts.claim: Seychelles' first settlement dates to 1770 (the French-led party). Note: Kreol dates Victoria itself to 1778; the 1770 settlement is of the islands, not verified as Victoria's site.

source.title: Seychelles
source.quote: Seychelles is a comparatively young Nation which can trace its first Settlement back to 1770.

facts.claim: The capital was named Victoria in 1841, during the administration of Mylius.

places.name: Victoria Clock Tower (Lorloz)
places.what: A clock tower at the centre of Victoria, inaugurated in 1903. It is called 'Little Big Ben' for its resemblance to the London clock tower.

source.title: Little Big Ben and a new cathedral: 5 historical events from past Aprils in Seychelles
source.author: Seychelles News Agency
source.quote: It was inaugurated on April 1, 1903, by Ernest Bickham Sweet-Escott, who was the governor.

source.title: Victoria Clock Tower
source.quote: dubbed 'Little Big Ben.'

source.title: Victoria Clock Tower
source.quote: was painted a dazzling silver.

source.quote: has stood proudly at the heart of Victoria for more than 123 years.

places.name: Sir Selwyn Selwyn-Clarke Market
places.what: The main open-air market of Victoria, where locally grown fruit and vegetables are sold. It is known locally as the bazaar.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: Large open-air market for local produce

source.title: Victoria: Capital of Seychelles - Celebrating its 240th Anniversary
source.author: Editor
source.quote: a large, open air market where locally grown, fresh fruit and vegetables may be obtained.

facts.label: Land for a market

places.name: Seychelles National Botanical Gardens
places.what: A botanical garden in Victoria that began as a plant-testing 'station' in 1901. It became a public botanical garden in the mid-20th century.

facts.label: Origin
facts.value: Began in 1901 as a botanic station under Paul Evenor Rivaltz Dupont
